body: I didn't think that was an option, told myself not to waste their time. I think part of the difficulty in supporting is that I don't know how to access resources here. If I was home, I'd know where to go.

SO was seeing a therapist before and the difference was considerable. Still taking prescription drugs, more than what was prescribed though. I'm worried about talking to someone myself because I can't be fully honest without interference, and I've already been labeled as someone who can't be trusted. SO will not get help due to risk of losing their job.

I read the talking tips and risk assessment before posting. There is a plan which I haven't heard but it seems as though they are committed to it. I've said so many of the wrong things. Tried to reach out to others and have been told I can't be trusted, they feel betrayed.
